about.sectionTitle: From the edges of technology into systems that carry real weight — both frontend and backend.
paragraphs: I started from the edges of technology, between urban memory, village roots, warnets, second-hand PCs, failed early attempts, and a long self-taught path. That path eventually led me into banking-grade systems, finance-domain services, and architecture work spanning both frontend and backend — from microfrontend migrations and component-driven UI to distributed contracts, secure integrations, and system alignment.

Today, I work across the full stack: React/Next.js frontend architecture, Golang microservices, and distributed contracts. At BRI QLola, I spent more time on the frontend layer — leading microfrontend migration, building responsive enterprise dashboards, and engineering state management for complex financial workflows. I am especially interested in the point where implementation grows into architecture, and where software becomes reliable enough to fade into the background.
My long-term direction is AI-first systems: not AI as a side feature, but AI as an operational layer that reduces friction, preserves continuity, and moves routine execution away from humans.
